gloss_chirho: † I. שׁוּשַׁן, שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן  n.m. שׁוֹשַׁנָּה n.f. usually lily, prob. any lily-like flower (TristrNHB 462 ff. Post Hast. D
† [שָׂטַם]  vb. bear a grudge, cherish animosity, against (NH שָׂטַם Niph., 𝔗 Gn 27:41 שְׂטַם; perhaps akin to שׂטן q.v.
† שִׁכֹּר, שִׁכּוֹר  adj. drunken (BaNB § 134 b);—abs. שִׁכֹּר 1 S 25:36, שִׁכּוֹר 1 K 16:9 +, f. שִׁכֹּרָה 1 S 1:13, pl
† שַׁלְוָה  n.f. quietness, ease;—abs. שׁ׳ ψ 122:7 +; cstr. שַׁלְוַת Ez 16:49; Pr 1:32; pl. sf. שַׁלְוֹתַ֫יִךְ Je 22:21
† I. שָׁמִיר  n.m. Ez 3:9 thorn(s), adamant, flint;—abs. שׁ׳ Is 5:6 +; sf. שְׁמִירוֹ 10:17;—1.  coll. thorns, thorn-bush
† שְׁמַע  vb. hear (v. BH);—Pe.  Pf. 3 ms. שׁ׳ Dn 6:15; 1 s. שִׁמְעֵת 5:14, 16; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁמַע 3:10, 2 mpl. תִּשְׁ
† [שִׁקֵּץ]  vb. Pi.   denom. detest, make detestable;—Pf. 3 ms. שִׁקַּץ ψ 22:25; Impf. 2 mpl. תְּשַׁקְּצוּ Lv 11:13 +,
† [שָׁקַר]  vb.denom. do or deal falsely;—Qal  Impf. 2 ms. תִּשְׁקֹר Gn 21:23 thou wilt not do falsely to me (לִי).Pi.
† [שְׁרָא]  vb.  1.   loosen  2.   abide (v. BH I. שׁרה);—Pe.  Inf. לְמִשְׁרֵא Dn 5:16; read מִשׁ׳ also v 12, for מְשָׁ׳
† [שָׂרַר]  vb. denom. (Gerber20) be, or act as, prince, rule;—Qal  Impf. 3 ms. וַיָּ֫שַׂר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל Ju 9:22 Abim.
